Good Morning, Traders! 👋

Today's reminder is about one of the most important skills in trading
Managing drawdowns.
Every trader experiences losing streaks. They're a normal part of the game, no matter how good your strategy is. What separates consistent traders from the rest is how they respond during those periods.
Here's a simple rule to consider:

📉 After two consecutive losses, reduce your position size by 50%.
Don't stop trading completely just trade smaller until you regain confidence and the market starts aligning with your strategy again.
Why does this work?
✅ It protects your trading capital.
✅ It reduces emotional pressure.
✅ It helps you stay disciplined instead of trying to "win it all back."

Remember, losing streaks are temporary, but poor risk management can do permanent damage.
Your goal isn't to avoid losses it's to make sure they never become account-threatening.
